newsitem.title: CHINA: China autumn/winter arable land up 3.0 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China autumn/winter arable land up 3.0 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China's arable land for autumn and winter crops rose three percent compared with the same period last year, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
Land under grain rose by 2.2 percent during the period while that under rapeseed increased by 0.6 percent, Xinhua quoted a survey of 40,000 farming households in 24 provinces as showing.
The area used to grow wheat increased by 1.6 percent while the area of land under other crops rose by 7.9 percent, Xinhua said but gave no further details.
China has forecast a record grain harvest of 480 million tonnes this year, up about 15 million tonnes from last year's output.
